head.title: Fixology Lab · Handyman Services in Miami, FL
head.description: Fixology Lab, Miami FL: TV mounting, plumbing fixes, painting and general home repairs. 5.0 stars, 35 Google reviews. Call +1 (305) 399-9649.
head.og_description: Reliable handyman services: TV mounting, plumbing, painting and more. 5.0 stars on Google.

script.es: Lo arreglamos bien, a la primera.

parrafo.es: Igor y el equipo de Fixology Lab montan TVs, arreglan plomeria, pintan y resuelven reparaciones del hogar en Miami. Trabajo limpio y puntual, de principio a fin.
parrafo.en: Igor and the Fixology Lab team mount TVs, fix plumbing, paint and handle home repairs across Miami. Clean, punctual work from start to finish.

parrafo_1.en: Fixology Lab handles home repairs across Miami: TV mounting, minor plumbing, painting, furniture assembly and wall repair. Igor checks every job before calling it done.
